ready1_open_rewrite.title: GeoSQA Open-ended Question
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: There is a “swallowing and spitting” relationship between one tributary of a certain large river and the main stream. The figure below shows the annual net runoff (the difference between output runoff and input runoff) and annual net sediment transport (the difference between output sediment amount and input sediment amount) at the outlet of this tributary during 1970—2000. Based on the graphic and textual materials and learned knowledge, answer: During 1970—2000, which time period had the closest changing trends of annual net runoff and annual net sediment transport? <image1>

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure the horizontal axis is year, with a range of 1970—2000; the left vertical axis represents annual net runoff, and the right vertical axis represents annual net sediment transport. The legend shows that the dotted line represents annual net runoff, the dashed line represents annual net sediment transport, and the horizontal solid line represents the multi-year average value of the two. Observing along the time axis, around 1970 both curves are in a relatively high or rapidly fluctuating state, around 1971 both decline obviously, around 1973—1975 both show rising and high-value fluctuations, and around 1976 both decline again. Then reason: The question asks to compare the time period when the changing trends of annual net runoff and annual net sediment transport are closest; one should see whether the two curves rise synchronously, decline synchronously, and whether the times of peaks and valleys are close. Comparing the stages from 1970—2000, within 1970—1976 the rising and falling rhythms of the dotted line and dashed line are most consistent, and the correspondence relationship of peaks and valleys is most obvious; after that, in many years the two show asynchronous changes. Therefore the time period when the changing trends of annual net runoff and annual net sediment transport are closest is 1970—1976.

raw_record.question_text:
There is a “swallowing and spitting” relationship between one tributary of a certain large river and the main stream. The figure below shows the annual net runoff (the difference between output runoff and input runoff) and annual net sediment transport (the difference between output sediment amount and input sediment amount) at the outlet of this tributary during 1970—2000. Based on the graphic and textual materials and learned knowledge, answer: During 1970—2000, which time period had the closest changing trends of annual net runoff and annual net sediment transport?

<image1>

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图中横轴为年份1970—2000，左纵轴对应年净径流量，右纵轴对应年净输沙量；图例显示点线为年净径流量，虚线为年净输沙量，实线为多年平均值。解题时沿横轴分段观察点线和虚线的形态，找出两条曲线同时上升、同时下降且峰谷出现时间最一致的时段。比较各段后，1970—1976年两条曲线的波动节奏最同步，因此确定该时段为答案。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中横轴是年份，范围为1970—2000年；左纵轴表示年净径流量，右纵轴表示年净输沙量。图例显示，点线代表年净径流量，虚线代表年净输沙量，水平实线代表两者的多年平均值。沿时间轴观察，1970年前后两条曲线都处于较高或快速波动状态，1971年左右都明显下降，1973—1975年前后都出现上升和高值波动，1976年前后又出现回落。再推理：题目要求比较年净径流量与年净输沙量变化趋势最接近的时间段，应看两条曲线是否同步上升、同步下降，以及峰谷出现时间是否相近。对比1970—2000年各阶段，1970—1976年内点线和虚线的升降节奏最一致，峰谷对应关系最明显；之后许多年份两者出现不同步变化。因此年净径流量与年净输沙量变化趋势最接近的时间段是1970—1976年。
method.answer_match_reason: 预测答案与标准答案表示同一时间段，仅连接符不同，语义完全一致。

answer_match_part_results.reason: 两者均指1970年至1976年这一时间段。
